belongs_to: Opening question: "Can you recognise the child in the picture who has made a full turn? Who has made a half turn? How do you know? Discuss in class." (statue game pictures)

A (boy, khaki shirt, brown shorts, hands raised in front), B (girl, khaki shirt, brown skirt), C (boy), D (girl, hair in a bunch) all stand side by side facing roughly towards the viewer/teacher side, bodies front-on or angled slightly. RIGHT panel (after): teal speech bubble from the teacher: 'STATUE!'. Same four children frozen in new facing directions compared with the left panel: A has his BACK to the viewer (facing away); B faces the viewer but turned slightly to the viewer's left (body angled), her hand touches C's arm; C faces the viewer/front (same way as before), one hand raised to his ear; D shows her side (profile) facing the viewer's right. belongs_to: Text: "A giant wheel makes a full turn when it comes back to the starting position E. Reema takes two half turns in the same direction. It is like a ______ turn.
